zh-CN.title: 反馈
zh-CN.context: 别人指出问题、要求修改，或评价你的成果与沟通时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次作答模式”这条自我感知线索。收到反馈时，建议验证：你能否把任务信息与对人格的评价分开，再选择回应。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把模糊评价还原成可讨论的事实；是否做得到，需要看真实反馈记录。
zh-CN.cost: 若把语气当成全部信息，或把任务评价听成人格否定，回应可能偏离问题。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：请对方指出一项具体行为及其影响。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 你能指出一个具体行为，以及它造成的影响吗？
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 若反馈含羞辱、威胁或明显权力压迫，先确保安全并寻求支持。
zh-CN.reflection_question: 在这个场景里，你是在处理事实、关系，还是自己的恢复空间？

en.title: Feedback
en.context: When someone identifies a problem, requests a change, or evaluates your work or communication.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “this response pattern.” In feedback, check whether you can separate task information from a judgment about you as a person before choosing a response.
en.strength: The useful possibility is turning a vague evaluation into discussable facts; verify it against actual feedback exchanges.
en.cost: If tone becomes the whole message, or task criticism becomes a character judgment, the response can miss the issue.
en.better_move: Do one thing: ask for one specific behavior and its impact.
en.one_sentence_script: Can you name one specific behavior and the impact it had?
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.
en.do_not_overread: If feedback includes humiliation, threat, or coercive power, prioritize safety and support.
en.reflection_question: In this scene, are you dealing with facts, the relationship, or your own recovery space?

feedback.risk_notes: Self-report scene translation only; not behavior prediction, diagnosis, hiring evidence, career recommendation, or advice for unsafe/high-conflict situations.

zh-CN.title: 冲突
zh-CN.context: 意见分歧、语气升高、彼此防御，或问题迟迟无法推进时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次作答模式”这条自我感知线索。冲突升温时，建议验证：你是否能区分当前争议、旧账和安全风险，而不是一次处理全部问题。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是看见冲突中真正需要处理的那一小块，而不是证明谁是对的人。
zh-CN.cost: 问题越堆越多时，解释、防御或退让都可能取代实际解决。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：把争议缩小到当前一个可处理的问题；不安全时停止对话。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 我们先只谈这一件事；如果现在不能安全地谈，我会先暂停。
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 有威胁、控制、暴力或明显权力差时，暂停不是失败，安全优先。
zh-CN.reflection_question: 在这个场景里，你是在处理事实、关系，还是自己的恢复空间？

en.title: Conflict
en.context: When disagreement, sharper tone, mutual defensiveness, or stalled problem-solving appears.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “this response pattern.” As conflict rises, check whether you can separate the current dispute, older grievances, and safety concerns instead of solving everything at once.
en.strength: The useful possibility is identifying the small part that needs handling now, rather than proving who is right.
en.cost: When issues pile up, explanation, defense, or concession can replace actual problem-solving.
en.better_move: Do one thing: narrow the dispute to one workable issue; stop the conversation if it is unsafe.
en.one_sentence_script: Let’s discuss only this issue; if we cannot do that safely now, I am going to pause.
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.
en.do_not_overread: With threat, coercion, violence, or a marked power gap, pausing is appropriate and safety comes first.
en.reflection_question: In this scene, are you dealing with facts, the relationship, or your own recovery space?

conflict.risk_notes: Self-report scene translation only; not behavior prediction, diagnosis, hiring evidence, career recommendation, or advice for unsafe/high-conflict situations.

zh-CN.title: 关系边界
zh-CN.context: 别人期待你理解、帮忙、让步，或继续承接情绪时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次作答模式”这条自我感知线索。面对他人的情绪或请求时，建议验证：你能否既承认对方感受，也如实说明自己能做与不能做的范围。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把关心与无限责任分开，让善意有清楚的边界。
zh-CN.cost: 只表达理解却不说明范围，容易让临时帮助变成长期义务。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：用一句话同时说出理解，以及能做和不能做的范围。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 我听见这件事让你很难受；我能做的是……，不能做的是……。
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 边界不能替代安全计划；控制、威胁或暴力情境应优先寻求现实支持。
zh-CN.reflection_question: 在这个场景里，你是在处理事实、关系，还是自己的恢复空间？

en.title: Relationship boundary
en.context: When someone expects understanding, help, concession, or continued emotional availability.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “this response pattern.” When another person brings a strong feeling or request, check whether you can acknowledge it while stating what you can and cannot take on.
en.strength: The useful possibility is separating care from unlimited responsibility so that support has a clear boundary.
en.cost: Expressing understanding without defining a limit can turn temporary help into an open-ended obligation.
en.better_move: Do one thing: use one sentence to acknowledge the feeling and state what is and is not within your limit.
en.one_sentence_script: I hear that this is painful; what I can do is …, and what I cannot do is ….
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.
en.do_not_overread: A boundary is not a safety plan; coercion, threat, or violence calls for real-world support.
en.reflection_question: In this scene, are you dealing with facts, the relationship, or your own recovery space?

relationship_boundary.risk_notes: Self-report scene translation only; not behavior prediction, diagnosis, hiring evidence, career recommendation, or advice for unsafe/high-conflict situations.

zh-CN.title: 团队协作
zh-CN.context: 多人协作、目标不清、责任交叉或节奏不一致时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次作答模式”这条自我感知线索。团队协作中，建议验证：你是否会在任务之外默默承担协调情绪和补位的工作。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是注意到任务与关系同时在发生，再把隐性负担说清楚。
zh-CN.cost: 角色不清时，最愿意协调的人容易长期承担没有被命名的责任。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：把当前困扰改写成角色、负责人和截止时间。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 这件事由谁负责、何时完成，遇到阻碍由谁决定？
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是协作观察，不是对团队成员或你本人能力的判定。
zh-CN.reflection_question: 在这个场景里，你是在处理事实、关系，还是自己的恢复空间？

en.title: Team collaboration
en.context: When several people work with unclear goals, overlapping responsibility, or uneven pace.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “this response pattern.” In teamwork, check whether you quietly take on emotional coordination or gap-filling beyond the task itself.
en.strength: The useful possibility is noticing task and relationship demands together, then making hidden work explicit.
en.cost: When roles are unclear, the person most willing to coordinate can inherit unnamed responsibility.
en.better_move: Do one thing: rewrite the current difficulty as roles, one owner, and a deadline.
en.one_sentence_script: Who owns this, when is it due, and who decides if it gets blocked?
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.
en.do_not_overread: This is a teamwork observation, not a judgment of anyone's ability.
en.reflection_question: In this scene, are you dealing with facts, the relationship, or your own recovery space?

team_collaboration.risk_notes: Self-report scene translation only; not behavior prediction, diagnosis, hiring evidence, career recommendation, or advice for unsafe/high-conflict situations.

zh-CN.title: 压力恢复
zh-CN.context: 持续忙碌、被催促或情绪消耗后，仍需要沟通或决定时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次作答模式”这条自我感知线索。压力累积时，建议验证：你能否识别注意力已经下降，而不是把硬撑误当成稳定。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把疲惫当作需要处理的状态，而不是人格缺陷。
zh-CN.cost: 缺少恢复时，调节可能变成压住感受，之后以迟钝、爆发或回避出现。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：在解释、承诺或决定前安排一次明确的短暂停顿。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 我需要十分钟恢复注意力，再给你一个清楚的回应。
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 持续失眠、强烈痛苦或功能受损需要现实支持，不能只靠微练习处理。
zh-CN.reflection_question: 在这个场景里，你是在处理事实、关系，还是自己的恢复空间？

en.title: Pressure recovery
en.context: After sustained demand, urgency, or emotional load, when communication or a decision is still required.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “this response pattern.” As pressure accumulates, check whether you notice reduced attention instead of treating endurance as steadiness.
en.strength: The useful possibility is treating fatigue as a state that needs care, not as a character flaw.
en.cost: Without recovery, regulation can become suppression and later appear as numbness, escalation, or avoidance.
en.better_move: Do one thing: schedule a defined short pause before explaining, committing, or deciding.
en.one_sentence_script: I need ten minutes to recover my attention, then I can give you a clear response.
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.
en.do_not_overread: Persistent sleep loss, severe distress, or impaired functioning needs real-world support, not only a micro-practice.
en.reflection_question: In this scene, are you dealing with facts, the relationship, or your own recovery space?

pressure_recovery.risk_notes: Self-report scene translation only; not behavior prediction, diagnosis, hiring evidence, career recommendation, or advice for unsafe/high-conflict situations.

zh-CN.title: 职业环境
zh-CN.context: 核对团队、管理方式、反馈节奏、人际密度与恢复空间时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次作答模式”这条自我感知线索。它不能决定适合什么岗位，只提示你核对哪些环境条件会影响沟通负荷、边界和恢复。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把抽象结果变成入职前或工作中的核对问题。
zh-CN.cost: 把环境偏好当成岗位匹配，会忽略具体职责、组织文化、管理者和生活阶段。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：核对压力升高时是否允许暂停、求助或交接。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 这个环境允许人在压力升高时暂停、求助或交接吗？
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这些是待验证的环境条件，不是岗位匹配、录用或绩效预测。
zh-CN.reflection_question: 在这个场景里，你是在处理事实、关系，还是自己的恢复空间？
zh-CN.scene_label: 需要观察的工作环境条件

en.title: Career environment
en.context: When checking team norms, management style, feedback rhythm, interpersonal density, and recovery space.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “this response pattern.” It cannot decide which role fits; it only points to work conditions worth checking for communication load, boundaries, and recovery.
en.strength: The useful possibility is turning an abstract result into questions for a real team or role.
en.cost: Treating environment preferences as job fit can miss actual duties, culture, management, and life stage.
en.better_move: Do one thing: verify whether people can pause, ask for help, or hand off work as pressure rises.
en.one_sentence_script: When pressure rises here, can people pause, ask for help, or hand work off?
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.
en.do_not_overread: These are conditions to verify, not evidence of job fit, selection, or performance.
en.reflection_question: In this scene, are you dealing with facts, the relationship, or your own recovery space?

career_environment.risk_notes: Self-report scene translation only; not behavior prediction, diagnosis, hiring evidence, career recommendation, or advice for unsafe/high-conflict situations.

en.do_not_overread: These are conditions to verify, not evidence of job fit, selection, or performance.

zh-CN.context: 别人指出问题、要求修改，或评价你的成果与沟通时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次结果：解释置信度不足”这条自我感知线索。收到反馈时，建议验证：你能否把任务信息与对人格的评价分开，再选择回应。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把模糊评价还原成可讨论的事实；是否做得到，需要看真实反馈记录。
zh-CN.cost: 若把语气当成全部信息，或把任务评价听成人格否定，回应可能偏离问题。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：请对方指出一项具体行为及其影响。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 你能指出一个具体行为，以及它造成的影响吗？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 若反馈含羞辱、威胁或明显权力压迫，先确保安全并寻求支持。
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。

en.context: When someone identifies a problem, requests a change, or evaluates your work or communication.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “Result status: Low interpretation confidence.” In feedback, check whether you can separate task information from a judgment about you as a person before choosing a response.
en.strength: The useful possibility is turning a vague evaluation into discussable facts; verify it against actual feedback exchanges.
en.cost: If tone becomes the whole message, or task criticism becomes a character judgment, the response can miss the issue.
en.better_move: Do one thing: ask for one specific behavior and its impact.
en.one_sentence_script: Can you name one specific behavior and the impact it had?
en.do_not_overread: If feedback includes humiliation, threat, or coercive power, prioritize safety and support.
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.

zh-CN.context: 意见分歧、语气升高、彼此防御，或问题迟迟无法推进时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次结果：解释置信度不足”这条自我感知线索。冲突升温时，建议验证：你是否能区分当前争议、旧账和安全风险，而不是一次处理全部问题。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是看见冲突中真正需要处理的那一小块，而不是证明谁是对的人。
zh-CN.cost: 问题越堆越多时，解释、防御或退让都可能取代实际解决。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：把争议缩小到当前一个可处理的问题；不安全时停止对话。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 我们先只谈这一件事；如果现在不能安全地谈，我会先暂停。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 有威胁、控制、暴力或明显权力差时，暂停不是失败，安全优先。
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。

en.context: When disagreement, sharper tone, mutual defensiveness, or stalled problem-solving appears.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “Result status: Low interpretation confidence.” As conflict rises, check whether you can separate the current dispute, older grievances, and safety concerns instead of solving everything at once.
en.strength: The useful possibility is identifying the small part that needs handling now, rather than proving who is right.
en.cost: When issues pile up, explanation, defense, or concession can replace actual problem-solving.
en.better_move: Do one thing: narrow the dispute to one workable issue; stop the conversation if it is unsafe.
en.one_sentence_script: Let’s discuss only this issue; if we cannot do that safely now, I am going to pause.
en.do_not_overread: With threat, coercion, violence, or a marked power gap, pausing is appropriate and safety comes first.
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.

zh-CN.context: 别人期待你理解、帮忙、让步，或继续承接情绪时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次结果：解释置信度不足”这条自我感知线索。面对他人的情绪或请求时，建议验证：你能否既承认对方感受，也如实说明自己能做与不能做的范围。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把关心与无限责任分开，让善意有清楚的边界。
zh-CN.cost: 只表达理解却不说明范围，容易让临时帮助变成长期义务。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：用一句话同时说出理解，以及能做和不能做的范围。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 我听见这件事让你很难受；我能做的是……，不能做的是……。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 边界不能替代安全计划；控制、威胁或暴力情境应优先寻求现实支持。
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。

en.context: When someone expects understanding, help, concession, or continued emotional availability.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “Result status: Low interpretation confidence.” When another person brings a strong feeling or request, check whether you can acknowledge it while stating what you can and cannot take on.
en.strength: The useful possibility is separating care from unlimited responsibility so that support has a clear boundary.
en.cost: Expressing understanding without defining a limit can turn temporary help into an open-ended obligation.
en.better_move: Do one thing: use one sentence to acknowledge the feeling and state what is and is not within your limit.
en.one_sentence_script: I hear that this is painful; what I can do is …, and what I cannot do is ….
en.do_not_overread: A boundary is not a safety plan; coercion, threat, or violence calls for real-world support.
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.

zh-CN.context: 多人协作、目标不清、责任交叉或节奏不一致时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次结果：解释置信度不足”这条自我感知线索。团队协作中，建议验证：你是否会在任务之外默默承担协调情绪和补位的工作。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是注意到任务与关系同时在发生，再把隐性负担说清楚。
zh-CN.cost: 角色不清时，最愿意协调的人容易长期承担没有被命名的责任。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：把当前困扰改写成角色、负责人和截止时间。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 这件事由谁负责、何时完成，遇到阻碍由谁决定？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这是协作观察，不是对团队成员或你本人能力的判定。
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。

en.context: When several people work with unclear goals, overlapping responsibility, or uneven pace.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “Result status: Low interpretation confidence.” In teamwork, check whether you quietly take on emotional coordination or gap-filling beyond the task itself.
en.strength: The useful possibility is noticing task and relationship demands together, then making hidden work explicit.
en.cost: When roles are unclear, the person most willing to coordinate can inherit unnamed responsibility.
en.better_move: Do one thing: rewrite the current difficulty as roles, one owner, and a deadline.
en.one_sentence_script: Who owns this, when is it due, and who decides if it gets blocked?
en.do_not_overread: This is a teamwork observation, not a judgment of anyone's ability.
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.

zh-CN.context: 持续忙碌、被催促或情绪消耗后，仍需要沟通或决定时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次结果：解释置信度不足”这条自我感知线索。压力累积时，建议验证：你能否识别注意力已经下降，而不是把硬撑误当成稳定。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把疲惫当作需要处理的状态，而不是人格缺陷。
zh-CN.cost: 缺少恢复时，调节可能变成压住感受，之后以迟钝、爆发或回避出现。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：在解释、承诺或决定前安排一次明确的短暂停顿。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 我需要十分钟恢复注意力，再给你一个清楚的回应。
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 持续失眠、强烈痛苦或功能受损需要现实支持，不能只靠微练习处理。
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。

en.context: After sustained demand, urgency, or emotional load, when communication or a decision is still required.
en.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “Result status: Low interpretation confidence.” As pressure accumulates, check whether you notice reduced attention instead of treating endurance as steadiness.
en.strength: The useful possibility is treating fatigue as a state that needs care, not as a character flaw.
en.cost: Without recovery, regulation can become suppression and later appear as numbness, escalation, or avoidance.
en.better_move: Do one thing: schedule a defined short pause before explaining, committing, or deciding.
en.one_sentence_script: I need ten minutes to recover my attention, then I can give you a clear response.
en.do_not_overread: Persistent sleep loss, severe distress, or impaired functioning needs real-world support, not only a micro-practice.
en.commercial_use: For result-page scene review, not behavioral or career judgment.

zh-CN.scene_label: 需要观察的工作环境条件
zh-CN.context: 核对团队、管理方式、反馈节奏、人际密度与恢复空间时。
zh-CN.typical_response: 本次作答显示“本次结果：解释置信度不足”这条自我感知线索。它不能决定适合什么岗位，只提示你核对哪些环境条件会影响沟通负荷、边界和恢复。
zh-CN.strength: 可用之处是把抽象结果变成入职前或工作中的核对问题。
zh-CN.cost: 把环境偏好当成岗位匹配，会忽略具体职责、组织文化、管理者和生活阶段。
zh-CN.better_move: 只做一件事：核对压力升高时是否允许暂停、求助或交接。
zh-CN.one_sentence_script: 这个环境允许人在压力升高时暂停、求助或交接吗？
zh-CN.do_not_overread: 这些是待验证的环境条件，不是岗位匹配、录用或绩效预测。
zh-CN.commercial_use: 用于结果页场景复盘，不作为行为或职业判断。

en.one_sentence_script: When pressure rises here, can people pause, ask for help, or hand work off?
en.do_not_overread: These are conditions to verify, not evidence of job fit, selection, or performance.
